fusions.name: Scouring Gale
fusions.desc: Drives a blast of iron filings on the wind in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to everything in it. Every hit leaves the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Filed Rasp
fusions.desc: Rasps a hardened edge of air across the target's armour, dealing 5 damage and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Set Like a Post
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rustless Reflex
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
